verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud-decisioning SaaS with SDKs, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out control. The items cover the Events API, webhooks, workflows, sandbox mode and status alerting, none of which address telemetry collection or disabling it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
